name: Spaces
note: The installer (bin/app_install.php, step 'registry') writes mcp/registries/spaces.json in the kernel from this file's `resolve` block plus mcp/action_registry.json. Each resolve tool answers a plain LIST of rows carrying id_field and label_field when given `q` alone (the kernel's resolver sends nothing else). The tools are the Phase 1 tool surface's names, built in Phase 4 (mcp/records_server.py; tests/phase4/registry.php resolves every entity through the live server with the kernel's own loader and resolver). Pages, databases and views are UUID-keyed: a resolver answers the UUID as the id. `view` resolves through get_database with `q` alone (a view by name across the databases you may see), `message` through channel_history with `q` alone (words of a message). A repeated param (blocks, members) and these ids are never resolved by name: block, comment, attachment, bookmark, reminder, section, request, dispatch, token, notification, shortcode.
